title: Fine and Gross Motor Function and Relationship With Muscle Tone in Older Adults With and Without Dementia
brief_summary: The purpose of this study was (1) to investigate changes in gait, balance, fine motor function, and muscle tone, and (2) to find out if there is a correlation between muscle tone/presence of paratonia and motor function (gross and fine) in mild and moderate dementia.Three groups of participants were included in the study: healthy elderly (n=60), participants with mild dementia (n=31) and participants with moderate dementia (n=31). Measurements of fine motor function, balance, gait, presence of paratonia and muscle tone measurements were performed.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* age \>= 65 years
* walk independently for at least 11 meters
* HC: no cognitive deterioration, MiD: dementia, Global Deterioration Scale\<5, MoD: dementia, Global Deterioration Scale 5 or 6

Exclusion Criteria:

* recent (≤ 6 months) orthopedic surgery
